_comment: Source of truth for asset provenance, licensing, and visual-style metadata. One entry per pack. See AGENTS.md in this folder for how to read, add to, and maintain this file. Every directory under assets/ MUST have an entry here.

kaykit.look: Flat-shaded low-poly, painterly hand-authored palette texture atlas, soft rounded forms, warm saturated colors.
kaykit.scale: Real-world-ish, Y-up, ~1 Godot unit = 1 meter. Humanoids ~1.7-1.8u tall. Dungeon pieces snap to a 1-unit modular grid.
kaykit.rig: Shared KayKit humanoid skeleton; all KayKit characters reuse the KayKit Character Animations set.
kaykit.texture: A single shared palette PNG atlas per pack (e.g. *_texture.png); recoloring = remap UVs on the atlas, not per-mesh textures.
kaykit.notes: This is the project's primary 3D style. New 3D should join this group whenever possible — same-creator is the only hard guarantee that models blend.

kenney-2d.look: Clean vector/flat UI and input-prompt iconography.

quaternius.look: Flat-shaded low-poly, cleaner/cartoonier than KayKit, single Atlas texture per model, slightly chunkier proportions.
quaternius.scale: Y-up, ~1 Godot unit = 1m, rigged humanoid armature (EnemyArmature/CharacterArmature) with its own animation set (Idle/Walk/Run/Attack/Death/HitReact).
quaternius.notes: A deliberate SECOND 3D style group, brought in for free CC0 animated monsters (KayKit has none free). Reads more cartoony than KayKit — acceptable for enemies, verified by in-engine side-by-side. Animation names differ per model; the enemy AnimationTree maps them per-monster.

unsorted.notes: Triage required — assign a real group or document why it stands alone.

game-ui.look: The game's own interface kit: hand-carved warm-brown wood with chipped, wandering edges, oversized gold curls that differ per corner, recessed translucent slots that glow ochre when filled and white when selected, a tone-on-tone scroll-relief backdrop, cream serif titles over curl-ended dividers. Storybook fantasy in the manner of recent Zelda remakes, kept muted: in-game UI is translucent shades and thin carved outlines, with heavy frames only on menus.
game-ui.notes: Rendered by asset-studio/ui/ui_kit.py and applied through scenes/ui/theme.tres. Fonts: Alegreya (display) and Alegreya Sans (body). New interface art extends the generator rather than mixing in third-party UI kits.

kenney-audio.look: Concise, cleanly recorded game sound effects with separate UI and RPG foley collections.
kenney-audio.notes: Audio provenance grouping; individual recordings remain subject to in-game audition and mix tuning.

opengameart-music.look: Individually selected loopable community music tracks; evaluate their mix and loop boundaries in gameplay.
opengameart-music.notes: Tracks are registered independently with their own source listing and license evidence.

opengameart-audio.look: Individually selected community sound effects for game playback.
opengameart-audio.notes: Sound effects are evaluated in-game for timbre, mix and repetition; keep the source listing and license evidence with each acquisition.

packs.name: CC0 creature skeleton and motion references
packs.author: Quaternius
packs.notes: Authoring-only wolf, rat, spider and blob rigs. Wolf: https://poly.pizza/m/P1gU3Qkr9r ; rat: https://poly.pizza/m/iltq5bVNaV . Public source-metadata.json records exact CC0 editions; profiles record hashes, clip maps, scales and bone roles. Spider/blob are existing project CC0 acquisitions. These source models are motion/weight references, not approved visual replacements or new gameplay enemies. Preserve original authorship and edition-specific CC0 evidence; current general site license differs.

packs.name: KayKit - Character Pack : Adventurers
packs.author: Kay Lousberg (KayKit)
packs.notes: Rigged/animated humanoid characters (Knight, Mage, Rogue, Barbarian) plus held weapon meshes. Player character source.

packs.name: KayKit - Character Animations (1.1)
packs.author: Kay Lousberg (KayKit)
packs.notes: Standalone animation set (no characters) as glTF: Rig_Medium (133 clips in General, MovementBasic/Advanced, CombatMelee/Ranged, Simulation, Special, Tools) and Rig_Large (fewer clips, a bigger skeleton with different proportions), plus bare mannequins. Rig_Medium matches the Skeleton_Warrior rig our kit characters use (same bones, rest pose identical), so its clips play on them unchanged; it omits the old IK/control helper bones. Clip names differ from the clips embedded in the older KayKit characters (e.g. 1H_Melee_Attack_Chop -> Melee_1H_Attack_Chop, Spellcast_Raise -> Ranged_Magic_Raise). FBX copies left out.

packs.name: KayKit - Dungeon Pack (legacy / pre-remaster)
packs.author: Kay Lousberg (KayKit)
packs.notes: Older dungeon prop/weapon set using the *.gltf.glb naming and rarity suffixes (_common/_uncommon/_rare). Kept alongside the remaster; prefer remastered where equivalents exist.

packs.name: KayKit - Dungeon Pack Remastered
packs.author: Kay Lousberg (KayKit)
packs.notes: Primary dungeon environment set (~200 modular pieces): walls, floors, banners, props. Drives level generation tiling.

packs.name: KayKit - Skeletons Character Pack
packs.author: Kay Lousberg (KayKit)
packs.notes: Animated skeleton enemies + modular skeleton parts/weapons. Current enemy source.

packs.name: Kenney - Input Prompts
packs.author: Kenney (kenney.nl)
packs.notes: Keyboard + Xbox controller button prompt SVGs for UI hints. Directory name keeps the original 'kenny' spelling.

packs.name: Rogue Gauntlet - Custom Generated 3D Items
packs.author: Rogue Gauntlet contributors (AI-assisted + KayKit palette)
packs.notes: Low-poly flat-shaded 3D items, each with its own palette texture baked from KayKit dungeon_texture swatches, aligned to KayKit reference AABBs.

packs.name: Rogue Gauntlet - Custom World Props
packs.author: Rogue Gauntlet contributors; bed_bedding lifted from KayKit Dungeon Remastered (CC0, Kay Lousberg); statues and the sarcophagus effigy carved from the KayKit Adventurers Knight and Mage (CC0, Kay Lousberg)
packs.source: Self-authored via asset-studio/studio.py item build/export from asset-studio/objects/<category>/<name>/ (furnishings: items/furnishings.py and items/foliage.py; borrowed pack parts: items/borrowed_parts.py; posed pack characters: items/pose_kaykit.py)
packs.notes: Procedural dungeon props from the Asset Studio item pipeline. fountains/ holds health and mana fountains (font, chalice, spring, tiered) with emissive liquid pools and the shared character palette shading; concept drawings: Google gemini-3-pro-image over the studio's knight style reference. The other folders hold room furnishings for generated Garrison rooms (altars, statues, candles, vases, racks, hearth, wall decor), one folder per room theme, sized to the KayKit dungeon remastered props and textured with KayKit's own dungeon_texture swatches and material. Art only; prop scenes, collision and effects live under scenes/.

packs.name: Rogue Gauntlet - Custom Dungeon Tiles
packs.author: Rogue Gauntlet contributors; dressed walls, alcove decor, water inlays (grate rims) and pool quay bricks derived from KayKit Dungeon Remastered (CC0, Kay Lousberg)
packs.source: Self-authored via asset-studio/studio.py tile build/export from asset-studio/tilesets/<set>/<family>.json
packs.notes: Modular floor, wall and rug tile families on the KayKit Dungeon Remastered footprints (4x4 and 2x2 floors, 4x4x1 walls with half and corner pieces, a cave doorway, gate and pillar, 4x4 rug pieces), one folder per tile set (dungeon/). Floors, rugs and the cave pieces are procedural and our own; the masonry and cave wall families stay out of the game until they are rebuilt at KayKit's face depth; wall_mossy, wall_overgrown, wall_slimy, wall_prison, wall_alcove and wall_crypt are KayKit's own dungeon walls dressed by script, and their alcove contents are KayKit decor props (books, bottles, candles, coins, keys, skull). Colors are KayKit dungeon_texture swatches baked into a per-tile palette texture; wall_cave and the dressed walls follow AI concept sheets kept beside their recipes (asset-studio/tilesets/dungeon/*.reference.png). Art only; mesh libraries, collision and room styles live under scenes/levels/.

packs.name: Rogue Gauntlet - Custom Monsters
packs.author: Rogue Gauntlet contributors; CC0 rigs/animations by Kay Lousberg and Quaternius; wolf/rat geometry adapted from Quaternius
packs.notes: Monsters built from the scripted character kit (heads, bodies, garments, armor and accessories by script), one folder per family: goblin/goblin (0.74x), mage/necromancer, mage/dark_wizard, orc/orc_king, orc/orc_warrior, orc/orc_shaman, undead/mummy, undead/wraith, undead/ghoul (0.92x), undead/zombie_walker and demon/imp (0.68x). Each GLB is a drop-in on a copy of KayKit's Skeleton_Warrior.glb (its Rig, 41 joints and 95 clips) with only the meshes ours; weapons are the game's own items baked in at true size. Sources (recipes, concept drawings by Google gemini-3-pro-image over KayKit's CC0 mannequin, previews) live outside the Godot assets in asset-studio/characters/. The earlier reconstructed monsters (2026-10-12) were removed. Selected wolf and rat are credited CC0 derivatives under beasts/, with bound sources and provenance in asset-studio/characters/beasts/. Stone golem is procedural rigid geometry on the local large rig. Studio exports art and animation metadata only; gameplay definitions are separate. The retired direct Quaternius gameplay pack was removed; adopted CC0 creature sources, rigs and provenance remain in Asset Studio. The active first-realm roster uses Studio rat art and the Warden in its own forsaken_warden/ export folder.

packs.name: Rogue Gauntlet - Custom KayKit-Rigged Heroes
packs.author: Rogue Gauntlet contributors (scripted character kit on KayKit CC0 rigs and clips)
packs.notes: Hero models built from the scripted character kit (head, body, outfit pieces). Each GLB is a drop-in for the KayKit adventurer it names as template (kaykit-adventurers/<Class>.glb): that model's Rig, 41 joints, baked clips and prop nodes (1H_Axe, <Class>_Hat, ...) are copied unchanged and only the meshes are ours, so size, orientation, clip names and attachment names match. Concept drawings: Google gemini-3-pro-image over KayKit's CC0 mannequin.

packs.name: UI fonts: Alegreya and Alegreya Sans
packs.author: The Alegreya Project Authors and The Alegreya Sans Project Authors / Huerta Tipografica
packs.notes: SIL Open Font License: free to bundle in commercial games; each font's OFL.txt must ship with the credits. Alegreya is the variable-weight serif (the theme picks weights with FontVariation); Alegreya Sans ships its Bold and ExtraBold static files.

packs.name: Rogue Gauntlet UI kit
packs.author: Rogue Gauntlet project (procedural, asset-studio/ui/)
packs.notes: Carved frames, plaques, slots, glow, card, divider, ribbon, header band, backdrop, feathered shade, thin outline frame, carousel arrows, gear-slot icons, touch action icons and the coin, all drawn from distance fields; regenerate with ./.venv/bin/python asset-studio/ui/ui_kit.py rather than editing the PNGs. Rendered at 1x for 1080p. title_logo.png is the title screen's logo, drawn by asset-studio/ui/title_logo.py from the glyphs of the project's Alegreya display font (OFL, see the fonts pack) at 2x.

packs.name: Kenney - RPG Audio
packs.author: Kenney Vleugels (Kenney.nl)
packs.notes: 51 OGG audio effects copied from the locally supplied Downloads pack. Original recordings are under audio/ with a filename-map.csv mapping from upstream names. License.txt is preserved as license.txt; Preview.ogg, URLs and archives are excluded.

packs.name: Kenney - UI Audio
packs.author: Kenney Vleugels (Kenney.nl)
packs.notes: 51 OGG audio effects copied from the locally supplied Downloads pack. Original recordings are under audio/ with a filename-map.csv mapping from upstream names. License.txt is preserved as license.txt; Preview.ogg, URLs and archives are excluded.

packs.name: MintoDog - RPG Metal Music
packs.author: MintoDog
packs.notes: Two OGG loops labeled CC0 on their individual OpenGameArt listings. Source filenames, author, license and per-track listing URLs are recorded in provenance.txt. Selected by the project maintainer for exploration and boss-music prototyping.

packs.name: OpenGameArt - Swishes Sound Pack
packs.author: artisticdude
packs.notes: 13 WAV swish effects from the freely downloadable pack; the OpenGameArt listing marks the pack CC0. The game copies are downmixed from stereo to mono for positional 3D playback. Imported as randomized melee-release variants to distinguish misses from contact impacts. Original filenames, conversion and source are recorded in provenance.txt.

packs.name: Kenney - Impact Sounds
packs.author: Kenney Vleugels (Kenney.nl)
packs.notes: The supplied Audio folder and License.txt are copied without changing the recordings. The pack includes surface footsteps and impact variants.

packs.name: Artisticdude - RPG Sound Pack
packs.author: artisticdude
packs.notes: The supplied WAV collection is copied with its category folders and original filenames. The OpenGameArt listing identifies this pack as CC0; see provenance.txt because the download did not include a license file.
